formulas.longest_run: longest consecutive hourly run with temperature_c <= 7

criteria.name: Requested JSON shape
criteria.description: Returns the five requested top-level fields with nested temperature, wind, and snow ledgers.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2 points if all metric groups are present but naming or nesting differs.

criteria.name: Temperature duration and load
criteria.description: Computes minimum temperature, hours at or below 7 C, longest cold run, and cold-load degree-hours with stated rounding.
criteria.partial_credit: Give up to 3 points for correct threshold counting but an incorrect or missing cold-load formula.

criteria.name: Wind coupling
criteria.description: Computes peak gust, cold-plus-gust overlap hours, and minimum wind chill from temperature and 10 m wind speed.
criteria.partial_credit: Give up to 2 points if the overlap count is correct but wind chill is rounded or formula-applied incorrectly.

criteria.name: Snow-depth gate
criteria.description: Uses total snowfall and maximum snow depth to fail the snow-accumulation gate.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for using snowfall alone without the depth gate.

criteria.name: Final label
criteria.description: Labels the episode as sustained cold surge with wind chill rather than snow accumulation.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point if the label names cold surge but omits wind chill or the snow contrast.

criteria.name: Rounding and units
criteria.description: Reports units or unit-implied field names and applies the requested decimal precision.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for correct values with inconsistent precision.

provenance.notes: All numeric values are rebuilt from local CSX-037 package files.
